fact: The SAPS Annual Performance Plan 2025/26, tabled 4 April 2025, lists CAS/ICDMS among the department's digitalised crime detection and investigation systems, sets a 2025/26 IS/ICT deliverable of 50% functionality integration for enhanced case docket management, anticipates R2,998 billion of expenditure for Technology Management Services in 2025/26 and names SITA as the provider of outsourced IT services.
title: Annual Performance Plan 2025/2026
